library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
divs = function(w,ml,mb,mt,bg,h) { paste0("display: inline-block;vertical-align:bottom; width:",w,";margin-left:", ml,"; margin-bottom:", mb,";margin-top:", mt,
                                          ";background-color:",bg,";height:",h,";") }
sheetname = "1fbxi0gsUxb9lJgli9LJL8PNKSwWiMvHx8UfjvMNzuuQ"
sheetname2 = "StockData"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
place <-  read.csv(url)
place$Date = as.Date(place$Date)

place <<- place

sheetname = "1riSYdnvql9O5OkVBlVEAw1ic3_gG0iRDxePvXP0KCyw"
sheetname2 = "ocean"
url <-  paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",sheetname,"/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=",sheetname2)
ocean <<-  read.csv(url)

ui <- fluidPage(
  h3("upldate-2.0"),
  selectInput("stocklist","",choices = unique(ocean$Symbol),selected = ocean$Symbol[1]),
  plotlyOutput("plot"),
  DTOutput("ocean")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  observe({
    d = place %>% filter(Symbol %in% "MSFT" & !is.na(Price))
    dmax = max(d$Date)
    output$plot = renderPlotly({
      data = place %>% filter(Symbol %in% input$stocklist & grepl("2",num))

      data = as_tibble(data)
      data = data %>% arrange(Date)
      a = data %>% group_by(Symbol) %>% slice_min(order_by = Date,n = 1) %>% select(Close = Price,Symbol)
      data = data %>% left_join(a, by = "Symbol")
      data$Change = round(100*(( data$Price - data$Close)/data$Close),2)
      
      a = data %>% group_by(Symbol) %>% slice_min(order_by = Date,n = 1) %>% select(zTrend = Price,Symbol)
      data = data %>% left_join(a, by = "Symbol")
      data$yhat = round(100*(( data$yhat - data$zTrend)/data$zTrend),2)
      
      a = data %>% group_by(Symbol) %>% slice_min(order_by = Date,n = 1) %>% select(zUpper = Price,Symbol)
      data = data %>% left_join(a, by = "Symbol")
      data$trend_upper = round(100*(( data$trend_upper - data$zUpper)/data$zUpper),2)
      
      a = data %>% group_by(Symbol) %>% slice_min(order_by = Date,n = 1) %>% select(zLower = Price,Symbol)
      data = data %>% left_join(a, by = "Symbol")
      data$trend_lower = round(100*(( data$trend_lower - data$zLower)/data$zLower),2)
      data$Price = data$Change
      
      
      vline <- function(x = 0, color = "green") {
        list(type = "line",y0 = 0,y1 = 1, yref = "paper",
             x0 = x,x1 = x,line = list(color = color, dash = "solid")) }
      fig <- plot_ly(data, x = ~Date, y = ~trend_lower, name = 'Lower', type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
                     line=list(color=c('gray'),dash = "solid"))
      fig <- fig %>% add_trace(y = ~trend_upper, name = "Upper", mode = 'lines', fill = "tonexty",
                               fillcolor='rgba(216, 247, 255, 0.5)',line=list(color=c('black'),dash = "solid"))
      fig <- fig %>% add_trace(y = ~yhat, name = 'Trend', mode = 'lines', fill = "tonexty",
                               fillcolor='rgba(216, 247, 255, 0.5)',line=list(color=c('#004568'),dash = "solid"))
      fig <- fig %>% add_trace(y = ~Price, name = 'Price', mode = 'lines',line=list(color=c('green'),dash = "solid"))
      a = max(na.omit(data$Price))
      b = max(na.omit(data$trend_upper))
      c = max(na.omit(data$yhat))
      amax = max(a,b,c) *1.1
      a = min(na.omit(data$Price))
      b = min(na.omit(data$trend_upper))
      c = min(na.omit(data$yhat))
      amin = min(a,b,c) *.90
      brange = as.numeric(max(data$Date) - min(data$Date))
      brange = brange/14  
      a = data %>% na.omit()
      a = max(a$Date)
      c = place %>% na.omit(Price)
      bdate = max(c$Date)
      fig = fig %>% layout(annotations = list(text = paste0(format(a,"<b>%b %d-%Y"),"—"),  x = bdate, y = amax * .95 ,showarrow=FALSE ),
                           shapes = list(list(type = "rect", text = 'decline1', fillcolor = "white", line = list(color = "green"),
                                              opacity = 0.1, y0 = 0.6, y1 = amax, x0 = dmax, x1 = max(data$Date)),
                                         vline(dmax,text)))
      
      Noax <- list(title = "", zeroline = FALSE,
                   showline = FALSE, showticklabels = TRUE,
                   side = "right", showgrid = TRUE, fixedrange = F,
                   range = c(amin,amax),
                   ticks = F,
                   rangemode = 'tozero', zerolinewidth = 5,
                   rangemode = 'tozero', showgrid = FALSE, showline = T, ticks = 'inside' )
      
      fig = fig %>%
        layout(hovermode = "x unified") %>%
        layout(
          showlegend = F,
          list(showgrid = TRUE),
          legend = list(orientation = 'h'),
          xaxis = list(title = list(text = '', font = list(size = 12)),
                       fixedrange = F, showgrid = TRUE, ticks = 'outside', 
                       type = 'date', hoverformat = "<b>%b %d, %Y"), 
          yaxis = Noax
        ) %>% config(displayModeBar = F)
      
      az = "%Y"
      fig <- fig %>% layout(xaxis = list(tickformat = az))
      fig
      
    })
  })
  output$ocean = DT::renderDataTable(DT::datatable(ocean[,1:10]))
}

shinyApp(ui, server, options = list(launch.browser = TRUE,port = 2030))
